newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Pearl mulls sales of office property.
newsitem.headline: Pearl mulls sales of office property.

text.p: Pearl Oriental Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it was in talks to sell an office floor in Shun Tak Centre in Hong Kong's Central district for not less than HK$330 million.
"The group is now negotiating with various potential buyers on the sale of 35/F, the remaining floor hold by the group at Shun Tak Centre," the company said in a statement.

"It is expected that the sale will be concluded shortly and the sale price is anticipated to be not less than HK$330 million," it said. Earlier this month, the company had agreed to sell the 34 floor of Shun Tak Centre for HK$330 million.

Pearl Oriental also said it had rejected an offer from an unidentified investor for the purchase of its wholly-owned Genesis project at Hong Kong's Peak for HK$900 million, or HK$33,000 per share foot.
"The management believe such price cannot fully reflect the value of the project, hence the offer had been rejected," the company said.

Pearl Oriental said it would consider acquiring suitable land site for development of five-star hotel in Hong Kong and it would also seek opportunities to acquire a five-star international hotel management chain.
